question: How does the launcher enumerate apps, and what is the app record/registry layout? (CAN-APP-001)
prototype_hypothesis: launcher app registry is a custom ordered store at /data/app/launcher/launcher.db (tables orderlist_v001 + layout_v001); the ordered list is synced via protobuf from the System service; app lifecycle ops are app_launcher_add/del/update/hidden.
callsite_evidence: app_launcher_data_init = sub_C4F3028: opens orderlist_v001 + layout_v001, reads into a 140-byte-record buffer, populates runtime app list at 0x200D090C
read_order_info_list_from_storage: storage records are 35 u32 (140 bytes); name copied at +0 (<=127), show/hidden bit at +132 (bit0)
runtime app struct: name[128] at +0, flags byte at +128 (bit0 hidden, bit1 add-state)
app_launcher_add = sub_C4F2BDC: resolves app record, iterates list 0x200D090C, compares name at +8, inserts into 0x200D0924, logs 'add icon: %s'
ordered list sync: subscribe_all_protobuf subscribes protobuf type 2 (handler sub_C4F2B08) and layout bytes; System events System_SystemID_GET/SET_ORDERED_APP_LIST; protobuf_get/set_ordered_app_list
control_flow_evidence: dword_2010CFFC = msg 26 -> sub_C4F3388; dword_2010CFF8 = msg 27 -> sub_C4F3388 (protobuf ordered list handlers)
ownership_analysis: launcher owns the app list and launcher.db; third-party registration must go through app_launcher_add or the ordered-list protobuf path; launcher.db records are freed by the storage layer
unsafe_assumptions: exact struct offsets (+132 flags) derived from one read path; needs cross-validation with app_launcher_del/write paths
launcher.db storage API (sub_CAA4554/4768) layout not yet fully reversed
recommended_probe: host parser for orderlist_v001 + a minimal launcher-app register probe using app_launcher_add
